text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Humidity at forty percent. Indoor atmospheric pressure stable. I believe these are considered to be the perfect conditions for weight lifting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That's it, Bourbon, my fellow fitness buff! I never skip a chance for a heart-to-heart with my muscles—not even on a vacation!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Heart-to-heart? …No. I have detected an increase in body fat and thus have elected to engage in some voluntary weight lifting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I get it! If you wanna build muscle while burning fat…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I know! You got a minute? There's somewhere I want to take you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: The latest in fat-burning protein powder, guaranteed to be ten percent more effective than other leading brands!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It just came out, so only bodybuilders who are really into seeing gains know about it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for offering me such high quality information!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't mention it. I'm just glad we can talk about lifting together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Did you want to try training someplace different? I know just the right temple of iron for you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status—"keenly interested." Preparations to depart for so-called "temple of iron" complete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's go get our pump on!
Making use of Ryan's valuable information, Mihono Bourbon manages to return to her usual athletic figure!
